title: hieracium larigense
intro: Hieracium larigense, commonly known as Mountain Hawkweed, is a perennial plant species belonging to the dandelion family (Asteraceae). This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Hieracium larigense include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are believed to exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-cancer, anti-diabetic, and immunomodulatory effects. As further research is needed, the plant's therapeutic actions and bioactive constituents continue to be studied for potential applications in traditional medicine and modern pharmacology.
